beats.care: Save 112 and 100 — they run 24x7. Grab the Puja Guide Map 2026 to plan routes. Breakdown vans will be on Maa Flyover.
beats.what: Police Commissioner Ajay Nand said leave is cancelled for all police. About 6,000 civic volunteers and home guards are included.
beats.why: Lakhs of people crowd pandals at night, so the police want quick help for emergencies, lost children and traffic.

cards.body: Includes about 6,000 civic volunteers and home guards.
cards.caption: Personnel on Puja duty

cards.body: Ambulances will wait at 14 locations. Breakdown vans will stand on Maa Flyover for the Salt Lake–New Town rush.

opts: To reunite lost kids with families fast
cards.q: Why are ID badges being given to children?
cards.why: Badges help police quickly match lost children with their families in crowds.

hook: Lost in the Puja crowd? Here's *Kolkata Police's plan*.

learn.t: Kolkata Police has 1 lakh ID badges for children, so lost kids can be reunited with families quickly.
